answer: What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A anchor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lagoon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
